title: Cameron Mackintosh gives £2m to 100-year-old actors' home for Attenborough building
summary_full: Sir Cameron Mackintosh's generous donation of £2 million to Denville Hall marks a significant step in supporting assisted living facilities dedicated to the performing arts, particularly with the new center being named in honor of Richard and Sheila Attenborough. Denville Hall, known for its commitment to care, has initiated a £26 million Centenary Appeal to further improve its offerings, backed by the support of many celebrated entertainment industry figures.
